## Vesta 1.2.3

### Changes

- Casual "Big Head" mode: heads that grow or shrink with a player's score are followed exactly. Chams, the head circle, the box and every hitbox check (aim, trigger, seed trigger, penetration, hit marks) use the scaled head.
- No Flash and No Smoke redrawn: the map as lit surfaces with sun shadows, the same with edge lines, or lines only. Anti-aliased, and the lines no longer flicker; style, shadows, colours, line width and render distance are in the settings.
- No Smoke shows everything a smoke hides from view, and the whole map from inside a smoke, with a soft smoke edge. Smokes have one fixed size for No Smoke and the visibility checks, so the edge no longer jumps.
- ESP editor: the head circle and the hitbox capsules on the 3D model come from the model's own hitboxes, also in the main menu.
- Misc → General: Auto Accept at the top left; the game binds are split into movement and action binds.
- Walk Bot Auto Buy presets start empty; items are added as needed.
- Overlay First takes a higher GPU priority, and the overlay returns to compositor pacing after a hitch instead of staying on timer pacing.
